items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: Steve Willett, that one boy. Paddock.

ctx.x: Yeah, skeleton in the closet. Oh, that's a lot.

Boy, they played that. And this boy was so close to him. Boy, I don't know how he just did it, but he did it. He couldn't do anything, boy, but that one. Yeah. Well, he come up with that trumpet, see? He come all his life. He ain't love it, see? Well, you're sick, man. He got me sick, boy. Trying to blow the other thing, man. You can't blow the other thing. Put that thing up, boy. He didn't want to put it down, man. Yeah. But you can't go get the old man up there. Sure. Oh, yeah? Sure, but we played at the, uh,…
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
